title: 공군방공관제사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Emergency Military Measures, etc.)
(1) Where emergency measures are necessary for military purposes or in response to a disaster, the Commander may temporarily direct and supervise units that are located within the area of jurisdiction determined by the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command pursuant to Article 2 but are neither organically subordinated to nor attached to the Command.
(2) Where the Commander directs and supervises units that are neither organically subordinated to nor attached to the Command pursuant to paragraph (1), the Commander shall, without delay, report the circumstances to the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command and notify the commanders of the superior units to which the units concerned belong.
